mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT form.number) as settledCount, IFNULL(SUM(pay.payprice), 0) as settledAmount, IFNULL(SUM(pay.payprice), 0) as settledPaid FROM t_erp_purchase_form_payment pay INNER JOIN t_erp_purchase_form_entry entry ON entry.id = pay.formentryid INNER JOIN t_erp_purchase_form form ON form.id = entry.formid WHERE pay.acct = #{acct,jdbcType=CHAR} AND pay.auditstatus = 1 AND pay.period_rollover_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) as orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.payamount), 0) as totalPayAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.confirmamount), 0) as totalConfirmAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.returnamount), 0) as totalReturnAmount FROM t_erp_purchase_alibaba_settlement_order o WHERE 1=1
AND o.settlementid = #{settlementid,jdbcType=CHAR}
